units.source_text: 眼前的眺望，使我怀疑起自己的眼睛来。

en.t: The view before my eyes made me doubt my own eyesight.

units.source_text: 京都解除了长期的灯火管制，全市是一望无垠的灯。

en.t: Kyoto had lifted its long-standing blackout, and the whole city was an endless expanse of lights.

units.source_text: 战后，夜晚我一次也没有登过这座山，对我来说，这股光景几乎是一种奇迹。

en.t: Since the war, I had not climbed this mountain at night even once, so to me this scene was almost a miracle.
